instruction.text: Match each term with its definition.

atoms.b: being alone or being able to keep information only to yourself.
atoms.sound: privacy is being alone or being able to keep information only to yourself.

atoms.b: the rules you set for yourself in relationships to decide what you are okay and not okay with.
atoms.sound: Personal boundaries are the rules you set for yourself in relationships to decide what you are okay and not okay with

atoms.b: touching or being touched by someone.
atoms.sound: Physical contact is touching or being touched by someone.

instruction.text: How should you communicate your personal boundaries with others? Select the four correct answers.

b: ++tell them what they’ve been doing that makes you uncomfortable
++tell them what things you are okay and not okay with
++tell them what they should do in the future
++be clear but also patient and understanding
accuse them of trying to upset you on purpose

instruction.text: Decide if each action is okay or not okay.

atoms.a: telling a stranger on the internet your full name
forcing someone to tell you their secret
offering a hug to your friend
giving someone space when they want to be alone
tickling someone to make them laugh even when they tell you to stop
understanding that your friends can’t always be available for you

instruction.text: What should you do if someone is acting inappropriately and they won’t stop? Select the four correct answers.

b: ++call Childline if you can’t talk to people around you
try to fight them to prove your strength
stay quiet about it to avoid trouble
